input.quote: 3.1 The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month. "Net Sales" shall mean all revenues from the sale of Deerskin Products on the Site including shipping and handling charges, minus refunds and exchanges.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no minimum purchase, minimum spend, guaranteed volume or take-or-pay obligation on the Company. HDI's compensation under Section 3.1 is purely a 30% share of actual Net Sales above an $11,000 monthly threshold (the threshold operates in our favour, as an exemption, not a floor), reconciled quarterly for refunds and exchanges under Section 3.3; HDI bears all development, hosting and promotion costs (Sections 1.2, 1.5, 1.8), and the Company's only cost obligation is order processing (Section 2.2). Searches for "minimum", "commit", "guarantee", "volume", "shortfall", "take or pay" and "purchase" return nothing. This sits at the preferred position: no commitment, and we pay only on actual sales/usage. Noted but not flagged here: the Section 4.2 Termination Payment (aggregate Net Sales for the twelve months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, halved) is an exit charge rather than a purchase commitment or shortfall penalty, and belongs to the termination-fee rule rather than MINCOMMIT; the exclusivity restriction in Section 6.1 is likewise a scope restriction, not a volume commitment, and is addressed under the exclusivity rule.
